headline: Geothermal Startup Seeks to Harness Power From Undersea Volcanoes
summary: Seattle-based Endurance E reached a proof-of-concept milestone toward capturing clean geothermal baseload energy directly from undersea volcanoes off the U.S. northwest coast.
why: Next-generation geothermal exploration represents a growing frontier for venture capital and utility procurement aimed at round-the-clock clean electricity.

impacts.name: Geothermal Energy
impacts.why: Demonstrating deep-sea thermal extraction viability expands potential non-intermittent renewable energy capacity.
